title: CoRATES Product Usage
description: What people actually do in CoRATES. Server-side domain events are authoritative; the client.* rows come from track() in src/lib/analytics.ts, which is batched, rate limited, sanitized and blockable, so Plausible remains the system of record for counts and these undercount. Production only; OTLP export latency is roughly 2-4 minutes.

list.name: user
list.label: User
list.description: Regex over userId. Leave as .* for everyone, or paste an id from the 'Who is active' table to follow one person. Honoured by the 'What they do' and 'Appraisal work' rows only - the other rows count events that carry no userId.

panels.title: Active users
panels.description: Distinct userId across every event that carries one, server and browser. userId is attached server-side, so browser events count the signed-in user, never a client-supplied id.

panels.title: Opened a project
panels.description: Distinct users who successfully connected to a project's sync session. The closest thing to a real active user.

panels.title: Orgs created
panels.description: org.created only covers orgs made through the orgs server function. Personal orgs created at signup are logged as interpolated prose ('Created personal org <id> for user <id>') and cannot be counted here.

panels.title: Rolling 24h active users
panels.description: Distinct users in the preceding 24 hours, evaluated at each step. Flat line means the same people; a step up is someone new.

panels.title: Who is active
panels.description: Events per user in the selected range. Name and email are resolved from the most recent auth.session_created over a fixed 365d lookback, not the dashboard range, so a user whose session predates the window still shows a name. Unknown means that user id has never emitted a sign-in - typically an account that was deleted. Copy a User ID into the User variable to filter the rows below to that person.

targets.expr: topk(25, sum by (userId) (count_over_time({service_name="corates-workers-prod", deployment_environment_name="production"} | json | userId!=`` | userId=~`$user` [$__range])))

topk(1, sum by (userId, userName, userEmail) (count_over_time({service_name="corates-workers-prod", deployment_environment_name="production"} |= `auth.session_created` | json | message="auth.session_created" | userEmail!=`` [365d]))) by (userId)

panels.title: Product actions over time
panels.description: Every product action, excluding request.completed, email.sent and billing traffic.

targets.expr: topk(25, sum by (message) (count_over_time({service_name="corates-workers-prod", deployment_environment_name="production"} | json | message=~`(auth\.session_created|org\.(created|updated|deleted|member_added|member_removed|member_role_updated)|project\.(created|updated|deleted)|pdf\.(uploaded|drive_imported|deleted)|invitation\.(created|accepted|cancelled)|member\.(added|removed|role_updated)|sync\.authorize_(ok|denied)|feedback\.submitted|contact\.sent|avatar\.(uploaded|deleted)|google\.disconnected|account_merge\.(initiated|completed)|client\..*)` | userId=~`$user` [$__range])))

panels.title: Actions by user

targets.expr: topk(40, sum by (userId, message) (count_over_time({service_name="corates-workers-prod", deployment_environment_name="production"} | json | message=~`(auth\.session_created|org\.(created|updated|deleted|member_added|member_removed|member_role_updated)|project\.(created|updated|deleted)|pdf\.(uploaded|drive_imported|deleted)|invitation\.(created|accepted|cancelled)|member\.(added|removed|role_updated)|sync\.authorize_(ok|denied)|feedback\.submitted|contact\.sent|avatar\.(uploaded|deleted)|google\.disconnected|account_merge\.(initiated|completed)|client\..*)` | userId!=`` | userId=~`$user` [$__range])))

panels.description: The direct answer to 'what is each person doing'. Sorted by volume; 40 rows max.

panels.title: Reconciliations finalized
panels.description: The core product outcome: two reviewers reconciled and the consolidated appraisal was finalized.

panels.title: Sent back to todo
panels.description: A completed checklist reopened. High relative to completions means people are second-guessing their appraisals.

panels.title: Local appraisals
panels.description: Appraisals started outside a project, in local-only mode.

panels.title: Checklist activity
panels.description: Browser events only. Checklist work happens in Y.js and syncs peer to peer, so the server never sees it - these browser events are the only record of the actual research work.

panels.title: Checklists by instrument

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (type, message) (count_over_time({service_name="corates-workers-prod", deployment_environment_name="production"} | json | message=~`client\.(checklist|local_appraisal|reconciliation)\..*` | type!=`` | userId=~`$user` [$__range])))

panels.description: The `type` prop on each browser event - which appraisal instrument is being used.

panels.title: Project opens
panels.description: Every successful sync connection, split by whether the user could write.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (projectId) (count_over_time({service_name="corates-workers-prod", deployment_environment_name="production"} | json | message="sync.authorize_ok" [$__range])))

panels.title: Members added directly
panels.description: Existing users added without an email invitation.

panels.title: Invitation acceptance

targets.expr:
sum(count_over_time({service_name="corates-workers-prod", deployment_environment_name="production"} | json | message="invitation.accepted" [$__range]))
  /
sum(count_over_time({service_name="corates-workers-prod", deployment_environment_name="production"} | json | message="invitation.created" [$__range]))

panels.description: Acceptances divided by invitations sent in the range. Acceptance lags the invite, so short ranges understate it.

targets.expr: topk(12, sum by (role, message) (count_over_time({service_name="corates-workers-prod", deployment_environment_name="production"} | json | message=~`invitation\.(created|accepted)` | role!=`` [$__range])))

panels.title: Sync access denied

targets.expr: topk(12, sum by (reason, projectId) (count_over_time({service_name="corates-workers-prod", deployment_environment_name="production"} | json | message="sync.authorize_denied" [$__range])))

panels.description: reason=auth-required is a signed-out visitor hitting a project URL. Anything else is a permissions problem worth reading.

panels.title: PDF bytes added

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({service_name="corates-workers-prod", deployment_environment_name="production"} | json | message=~`pdf\.(uploaded|drive_imported)` | keep size | unwrap size [$__range]))

panels.description: Sum of the `size` field. keep size collapses the label set before unwrapping, otherwise every request is its own series.

panels.title: Drive share of PDFs

targets.expr:
sum(count_over_time({service_name="corates-workers-prod", deployment_environment_name="production"} | json | message="pdf.drive_imported" [$__range]))
  /
sum(count_over_time({service_name="corates-workers-prod", deployment_environment_name="production"} | json | message=~`pdf\.(uploaded|drive_imported)` [$__range]))

panels.description: How much of the PDF intake comes through the Google Drive picker rather than direct upload.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (projectId, message) (count_over_time({service_name="corates-workers-prod", deployment_environment_name="production"} | json | message=~`pdf\.(uploaded|drive_imported|deleted)` [$__range])))

topk(12, sum by (category) (count_over_time({service_name="corates-workers-prod", deployment_environment_name="production"} | json | message=~`(feedback\.submitted|client\.feedback\.submitted)` | category!=`` [$__range])))

panels.title: Recent sign-ins
panels.description: Identity lookup for any user id that appears without a name elsewhere.

panels.title: Feedback and contact messages
panels.description: Bodies are not logged - these are the submission events. Read the actual text in the DB by feedbackId.
